lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ender de Souza Batista | Lesson 8 -- The Team Page
lesson.grammar_point: possessive adjectives (my, your, his, her, our, their) + possessive 's (Sarah's team)

listenings.text: Before we start, let me introduce my team. I'm Sarah, and I'm the manager of the global partner team. This is Lisa, my assistant. Her job is our calendar, so her emails are important! My boss is David. His office is in London. And these are Raj and Anil, from Pune. Raj is an engineer, and Anil is his manager. Their department is Technology.

Hello, I'm David Brown. I'm the director of the partner department, here in London. My department is thirty people, in five countries. My assistant is Emma; her desk is next to my office. Sarah's team is in New York, and it is our best team. Their calls with Brazil and India are every week. My job? I listen to their problems and I help.

extra_audio.text: Sarah is the manager of the global team. Sarah's boss is David, in London. Raj is an engineer, and his manager is Anil. Lisa is Sarah's assistant. Ender is the partner in Brazil.

vocab.title: Match each word to its meaning
defs: a person who builds and fixes systems
one part of a company, like Technology or Sales
a person who helps another person with the work
a person who works with you, in your company
the person in charge of a team

paras: This is the page of the global partner team. Sarah Miller is the manager. Her office is in New York, and her team works in three countries. Sarah's boss is David Brown. His office is in London.
Raj Patel is an engineer. His office is in Pune, in India. His manager is Anil, and his colleagues are four engineers. Their department is Technology. Raj's big job is the change windows.

Lisa Chen is Sarah's assistant. Her desk is next to Sarah's office. She schedules the calls and sends the invites. And our partners in Brazil? Their contact is Ender, the technology director. His team tests the payments.
